GMB.note: Document covers payments of taxes, fees and levies by citizens, not e-procurement.
No central bank role is stated.
No consumer rules or complaints body stated.
Diaspora can pay for services from abroad, but no named corridor, regional system or figure is stated.
Payments are from people to government, not government to people.
No survey figure on account holding is given.

facts.fact: The document says APS Wallet, a mobile wallet, lets Gambians pay government taxes, fees and levies from their phones through GovPay under an agreement signed 9 April 2026.

The document says Gambians can now pay taxes, fees and levies electronically through GovPay, the government's digital payment platform, via APS Wallet, per the Accountant General's Department agreement signed 9 April 2026.
